title: amaracarpus grandifolius var. humilis
intro: Amaracarpus grandifolius var. humilis, commonly known as "Tetradenia humilis", is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tetradenia humilis include its ability to reduce fever, treat respiratory issues, and provide relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
